InventoryStock.title: Inventory Stock
InventoryStock.description: Stock-on-hand snapshot per Product per Location (Tryton / Odoo style aggregate). Carries the four quantity states required by Dutch SMB warehouse operators: quantityOnHand (physical), quantityReserved (allocated to pending orders / production), quantityInTransit (en route from supplier or between locations) and quantityAvailable (computed: quantityOnHand - quantityReserved, read-only at query time). One row per (productSku, locationCode, administrationId) — enforced via x-openregister-unique. Updated declaratively by downstream inventory-stock-movement-ledger StockMove postings (the materialisation hook documented in design.md D5); pre-StockMove the records are seeded by SettingsService::seedInventoryStockExamples() and edited manually. Multi-tenancy is scoped by administrationId per REQ-IST-007. The reservation guard (StockReservationGuard::checkReservationDoesNotExceedOnHand) refuses quantityReserved > quantityOnHand at create + update per REQ-IST-013 — the only ADR-031 exception in this fragment. No PHP InventoryStockMapper / lib/Db table per ADR-024 — the register IS the persistence.

productSku.description: FK to Product.sku (inventory-product-catalog). Required. Cardinality many-to-one — one Product has 0..N InventoryStock rows (one per location).

locationCode.description: FK to Location.code (budget-planning-control). Required. Represents a physical container — warehouse, regional distribution centre, retail store, repair depot, returns bin. Operators define the master data; this snapshot is scoped per code.

locationName.description: Denormalised human-readable Location name for the operator UI (avoids a JOIN on every list render). Updated via materialisation when the underlying Location is renamed.

quantityOnHand.description: Physical quantity in the location. Decimal (2-decimal precision) to support fractional units (0.5 L, 2.25 kg) per design.md D1. May briefly be negative on backorder edge cases — application-level enforcement (REQ-IST-013) blocks the common case.

quantityReserved.description: Quantity allocated to pending sales orders, production plans or pending shipments. Not available for new allocations. quantityReserved <= quantityOnHand is enforced by StockReservationGuard::checkReservationDoesNotExceedOnHand per REQ-IST-013.

quantityInTransit.description: Quantity en route from a supplier or between this app's locations. Not yet in the destination's quantityOnHand — increments on transfer dispatch, decrements (transferring to quantityOnHand) on transfer receipt per design.md D1 + REQ-IST-003.

quantityAvailable.description: COMPUTED. quantityOnHand - quantityReserved. Calculated at every retrieval; MUST NOT be stored per REQ-IST-008. The expression in x-openregister-calculations drives the value on every list and detail render.

unitCost.description: Standard or average cost per unit at the time of the most recent receipt or manual adjustment. Currency follows the linked Product.currency. Used by P&L (COGS = issued quantity * unitCost) and balance sheet valuation (asset value = quantityOnHand * unitCost). FIFO / average variance is handled by inventory-valuation-fifo-avg downstream.

lastRestockDate.description: Timestamp of the most recent stock movement that increased quantityOnHand (receipt, transfer-in, manual adjustment). Drives 'aging inventory' queries (lastRestockDate < today - 30 days) and replenishment planning.

status.description: Mirrors Product.status for filter efficiency (avoids a JOIN on 'active stock only' queries). Populated at creation from Product.status; updated when the product is later marked discontinued. Discontinued rows remain queryable for historical reporting; downstream specs MUST exclude them from new transactions.

administrationId.description: FK to Administration owning this stock record (REQ-IST-007 multi-tenant scope). Cross-administration reads / writes are masked 404 by AdministrationContextService — organisation A's 'Amsterdam Warehouse' is invisible to organisation B.

product.description: Product master record (inventory-product-catalog). Required. ?expand=product resolves the Product row for the operator UI; downstream stock-by-product reporting traverses this relation.

quantityAvailable.description: REQ-IST-008. quantityAvailable = quantityOnHand - quantityReserved. Computed at every retrieval (list, detail and aggregation paths) — never stored. The expression is the declarative DSL form; the runtime evaluator falls back to PHP-level computation in InventoryStockService::computeAvailableQuantity() when an aggregation or filter targets the field.

active.label: Active
active.description: Stock is in use for normal warehouse operations. Eligible for new reservations, transfers, and outbound stock moves. Updated by downstream StockMove posting per REQ-IST-001.

discontinued.label: Discontinued
discontinued.description: Mirrors Product.status = discontinued. Historical only — excluded from new transactions per REQ-IST-011 (enforcement delegated to downstream specs). Rows remain queryable for audit and aging reports.

discontinue.label: Mark discontinued
discontinue.description: Cascade from Product.status discontinue. Operator-initiated discontinuation closes the snapshot to new transactions while preserving the row for historical reporting per REQ-IST-011.

reactivate.label: Reactivate
reactivate.description: Restore an erroneously discontinued snapshot when the linked Product is reactivated. No quantity adjustment is applied; operator confirms the stock numbers separately.

reservationDoesNotExceedOnHand.message: Insufficient available quantity — quantityReserved cannot exceed quantityOnHand.
reservationDoesNotExceedOnHand.messageNl: Onvoldoende beschikbare hoeveelheid — gereserveerd mag voorraad niet overstijgen.

reservationDoesNotExceedOnHand.message: Insufficient available quantity — quantityReserved cannot exceed quantityOnHand.
reservationDoesNotExceedOnHand.messageNl: Onvoldoende beschikbare hoeveelheid — gereserveerd mag voorraad niet overstijgen.
